hash_status: The main task is adding an optional deadline callback after these executions and will capture the final source hash in its aggregate gates. The retained script computes the source SHA-256 when run.
source_scope: The recorded checks executed against CompiledPattern before the optional deadline callback was added; all calls used the default constructor arguments except the stated limit fallbacks.

exhaustive.fixture_rule: Every subset of the distinct NAE triples on n variables, for every n=0..5; every ternary partial assignment for every such pattern
exhaustive.presence_fixture: Empty pattern on 5 variables, every ternary assignment, all 5 presence indicators

random_n15.fixture_rule: 100 patterns: sorted random.sample of all 15-variable triples with count random.randrange(25); for every available pattern, 100 random ternary assignments and 10 additional random Boolean-selector assignments

limitations: Bounded implementation checks; no general theorem or general efficient SAT method is claimed. Retention added no tests and started no validation process.
